content.user_title: Create and Refine 3D Assets with Layer
content.value_statement: Unspecified topology, materials, and reference inputs can lead to unsuitable meshes and extra paid runs. This skill guides staged Layer workflows with model-specific settings and price checks.
actual_capabilities: Guide text-to-3D or image-to-3D generation based on available references and shape complexity.
Select use-case and texture-capability filters, then inspect the model schema before composing a run.
Specify quad or triangle topology, face limits, PBR materials, and texture inclusion when supported.
Chain remeshing and retexturing stages using existing mesh identifiers rather than regenerating suitable geometry.
Sequence rigging and animation with neutral rest poses and supported motion presets.
Guide price estimation, approval requests, polling, and result inspection in the documented mobile-prop workflow.
limitations: Execution requires access to Layer tools; this skill contains guidance rather than a standalone 3D engine.
Shared execution and spending controls depend on the sibling layer skill; reference-image preparation may require layer-image.
Supported parameters and motion presets depend on each model schema, and generation stages may incur separate charges.
Thin protrusions, chains, cloth, and hair may fail or fuse together; generated assets require inspection.

use_cases.title: Build a Mobile Game Prop
use_cases.description: Convert approved concept art into a textured static prop with a mobile face budget and price approval before generation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sculpting Geometry
use_cases.description: Request quad topology for an asset that needs sculpting or subdivision, then remesh if the initial topology is unsuitable.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Character for Motion
use_cases.description: Start with a neutral character mesh, generate its skeleton and weights, then use a supported animation preset.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Describe a Simple Mesh
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Layer mesh of a squat clay pot with a wide belly, flared neck, and two loop handles. Ask before any paid run.
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a simple shape without existing concept art.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Convert Approved Concept Art
prompt_templates.prompt: Use approved concept image [file_id] for a mobile static prop. Target [face_limit] faces with PBR textures. Inspect supported settings and request price approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use an existing image as the basis for a textured game prop.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Repair an Existing Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect mesh [file_id] for [target platform]. Preserve its silhouette, remesh toward [face_limit] faces, and retexture only if needed. Estimate each stage before proceeding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Correct topology or surfaces without regenerating acceptable geometry.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Chain Rigging and Animation
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan rigging and animation for neutral-pose character mesh [file_id]. Inspect supported motion presets and choose [motion]. Estimate each stage and request approval before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a staged character workflow with schema checks and spending approval.

output_examples.input: Plan a textured mobile prop from an approved concept image.
output: Select an image-to-3D model with texture support and inspect its accepted settings.
Request triangle topology, a mobile face budget, and PBR textures where supported.
Estimate the price and wait for approval before generation.
Inspect the mesh; remesh rather than regenerate if only the face count needs correction.

output_examples.input: Plan a walking animation for a neutral-pose character mesh.
output: Confirm that the character has a neutral rest pose with separated limbs.
Rig the mesh to produce a skeleton and weights after price approval.
Use the rigged output as the animation input and select a walking preset if available.
Review the resulting motion before accepting the asset.

best_practices: Approve a clean, evenly lit reference image before image-to-3D generation.
Specify the target platform, topology, face budget, and material requirements before estimating the run.
Inspect each model schema and stage output, and obtain approval before paid execution.
anti_patterns: Use dramatic shadows, camera language, or mood descriptions instead of clear geometry and suitable references.
Generate a character in an action pose before rigging, or expect clean thin geometry without inspection.
Regenerate the entire asset when remeshing or retexturing would fix the actual defect.

faq.question: Does this skill generate meshes on its own?
faq.answer: No. It guides Layer tool workflows and relies on available models and sibling skills for execution.

faq.question: Should I start from text or an image?
faq.answer: Use image-to-3D when the design is settled or a reference can be prepared. Text-to-3D suits simple shapes without existing references.

faq.question: When should I request quad topology?
faq.answer: Use quads for sculpting, deformation, or subdivision. Triangles are suitable for static props, subject to model support.

faq.question: How does the workflow handle generation costs?
faq.answer: The example estimates cost and requests approval before execution. Shared spending controls reside in the sibling layer skill, and additional stages cost extra.

faq.question: Can I animate an unrigged character mesh?
faq.answer: The documented animation stage requires a rigged mesh. Generate a neutral rest pose, rig it first, then select supported motion settings.

faq.question: Which defects should I fix without regenerating?
faq.answer: Use remeshing for topology or face-count problems and retexturing for surface changes when the existing geometry is acceptable.
